title: Ingredient
content:
Type: INGR
Papyrus: Ingredient Script, ObjectReference Script This object is depreciated, obsolete, or does not appear to be used by the game. Historically, Alchemy Ingredients were objects used to create potions at an Alchemy Lab in Skyrim. The Ingredient object is found within the Object Window under the Items Category.
